caption:
Figure 2: Overview of DeCo. Independent backbones extract multimodal, multiscale features, which
are projected into a shared density space to estimate modality reliability and construct density con-
sensus. The resulting consensus guides multiscale feature fusion for detection and is simultaneously
decoded into a density map for density supervision.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed all three complete original bands and added stage headings, read caption and eight checks. Optical/SAR mosaics, shared projector/softmax branch, reliability maps, fusion equations and all detection/density/loss panels remain unchanged. Preserved source Optical density encoder Ds wording and SAR tensor color instead of guessing corrections. New headings merely repeat original stage titles. Three complete scientific regions independently replayed.
